title: Amazingly Nutty American Cocoa Toast
description: A deliciously nutty and crumbly post-workout treat featuring cocoa powder and toast, perfect for flexitarian diets.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a small bowl, mix together the cocoa powder and sea salt.
Spread one side of each bread slice with almond butter.
Sprinkle the cocoa powder mixture evenly over the almond butter on each bread slice.
Place the bread slices, cocoa side up, on the preheated skillet or griddle.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is toasted and the cocoa is fragrant.
Flip the bread slices over and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Drizzle the honey over the toasted bread slices.
Top each bread slice with banana slices, chopped almonds, and shredded coconut.
